competing_explanation: If finite-difference secant bounds along 1D transport chords and batch-pool pairs leave orthogonal off-manifold critic directions unbounded, then replacing 2nd-order autograd.grad(create_graph=True) with 1st-order secants will allow actual Euclidean input gradient norms to blow up (two_pole grad_med > 1.0) or break multimodal/continuation gates (ring16_acquisition, gaussian1d_stability, five_word_joint_hold).
hypothesis: Pure 1st-order Variational Multi-Scale Secant Born-Infeld critic regularization (reusing live D(x_real), D(x_fake) logits plus one detached Chebyshev-Weyl transport-chord probe with all-pairs Kantorovich supremum secants on low-d manifolds and Weyl-cyclic secants on images) enforces actual 1-Lipschitz critic slope (two_pole grad_med <= 1.0) and preserves discriminator_stability Tier 1-2 gates on NVIDIA RTX A6000 under protocol seed 0 without create_graph=True double-backpropagation.
